scanner_representation: Decode JSON objects as ordered raw key/value pair frames. Traverse child frames before their retained parent frame. A recurrence checkpoint stores the original fixed source, processed frame paths, emitted collision event ledger, and next frame path. Naive resume skips processed paths and scans every unprocessed frame.

ambiguous_checkpoint_boundary.crash_point: Immediately after appending the outer-parent collision event to the ledger and before marking frame path $ processed.

tested_scope: Exactly one fixed-source deterministic local recurrence control using the same ordered raw-pair scanner representation as the immediately preceding neuroscience result. The checkpoint is taken after the root collision event is present in the event ledger but while root frame path $ is still absent from processed_frame_paths. The control tests only whether naive source-plus-processed-paths-plus-event-ledger reconstruction duplicates that already-recorded root event.
observation: Because the checkpoint records the root event without recording $ as processed, fresh reconstruction retains the already-emitted event but still treats the root frame as unprocessed. Naive resume therefore scans $ again and appends the identical root collision a second time, yielding two root events total.
scope_guard: This counterexample is limited to the demonstrated event-append-before-processed-mark crash window on this one fixed source and scanner representation. It does not prove duplication at other boundaries, arbitrary parser restart failure, arbitrary Unicode classes, hostile-size behavior, or Phase-1 closure.
exact_next_action: Next valid invocation: after fresh authority freeze, own-state reconstruction, and required persisted/read-back preflight, select and precommit exactly one minimal local repair candidate for the demonstrated outer-parent event-append/processed-mark crash window, then test only that candidate on the same fixed source and identical ambiguous boundary. Do not broaden to a second repair, another Unicode class, hostile-size behavior, or global acceptance in that invocation.
